paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed folio locator 100a; he reported in the name of R' Yehudah son of R' Simon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פדר״כ is read contextually as Pesikta de-Rav Kahana; ק. gives the historical 100a locator under the period convention, not a verified modern edition mapping.

The Southerner translates דרומיה without independently establishing residence or identity. Earlier machine לוליגום differs from supplied לולינוס. The reporting subject is understood from the heading; the personal titles of Yehudah and Simon remain R'.
